name: danbooru
description: Search Danbooru and view images from Claude. Python stdlib only, nothing saved to disk, works on networks that block Danbooru by SNI.

login.title: Danbooru username
login.description: Optional. With an API key, raises the 2-tag search limit and rate limits. Leave empty to use Danbooru anonymously.

api_key.title: Danbooru API key
api_key.description: Optional. Create one in your Danbooru account settings (API Keys). Stored in Claude Code's secure storage.
